title: When was the bill paid?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the total payment under differently timed labels.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the total payment under differently timed labels affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Final, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the total payment under differently timed labels in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
